steps.1: Bring one corner to the opposite corner. Line up both edges, then press the diagonal crease flat.
steps.2: Open the sheet. Bring the other pair of corners together, then press the diagonal crease flat.
steps.3: Open the sheet, then bring one straight edge to the opposite edge. Press the fold into a rectangle.
steps.4: Open the sheet, turn the fold a quarter turn, and fold edge to edge. Press the crease, then open it flat.
steps.5: Bring each corner point into the center. Keep the four points together, then press every triangular flap flat.
steps.7: Bring each corner to the center again. Keep all four points together, then press the smaller square flat.
steps.8: Fold the small square in half and press the crease. Open it, turn it, and repeat in the other direction.
steps.9: Slide your fingers under the four loose flaps. Push the pockets toward the center until the fortune teller opens.
